Claim amendment · #32086 · 2026-11-10T10:12Z · amends claim 6764573689 after the step-0 reading (Branch `claude/project-thread-hlv1i9` unchanged)

Seat rulings on step 0:
- **Split:** two PRs. PR-A = items 2 and 3 (`Part of #32086`), starts now. PR-B = item 1 (`Fixes #32086`), starts only after the maintainer's answer below. Each stays at or under 3000 lines.
- **Item 1 goes to the maintainer.** The third-party-initiated OIDC door changes what an unauthenticated GET can reach (a 302 to the IdP, a state cookie and one auth-state row where today it answers `state_not_found`), which is the human floor for authentication flows. It also meets ruling A on #30967 (6718355623: IdP-initiated sign-in "exposes what `@better-auth/sso` already implements; ⛔ no sign-in mechanism of our own"): the flow is the vendor's, but the `iss` entry is ours. Filed as a decision card; this card waits on it for item 1 only.
- **Item 2:** as designed: flat `mapEmail` / `mapFirstName` / `mapLastName` / `mapName` on register; two platform-admin bridges `POST /admin/sso/get-attribute-mapping` and `POST /admin/sso/set-attribute-mapping` on the groups-claim pattern, carrying the stored mapping's other members; OIDC served too (`email`, `name`). New public route names follow the groups-claim precedent.
- **Item 3:** not the human floor. The cause token is derived from the posted XML and the configured IdP certificate (public, in the IdP's metadata), before any user lookup, so it is the same answer for every account; same shape as the OIDC causes #30965 shipped. Closed list of four causes including `saml_issuer_mismatch`. `error=saml_error` stays.
- **Dependency:** `fast-xml-parser` `5.10.1` as a direct dependency of `@objectstack/plugin-auth` (already in the lockfile through `@better-auth/sso`; importer entry only).
- **Form params:** carried on this card, as the groups-claim edit shipped. No separate ui child.
- **Cloud:** the two new bridges need cloud mounts in `AuthProxyPlugin`: an `out_of_scope_findings` entry `carrier: cloud`.

File surface (PR-A): `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/register-sso-provider.ts`, `auth-plugin.ts`, `auth-route-ledger.ts`, new `sso-saml-refusal-cause.ts`, `sso-oidc-refusal-cause.ts` (one hook in the SAML branch), `auth-manager.ts` (`runSsoCallback`, one hook), their tests; `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` (the one importer entry); `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-sso-provider.object.ts` and its generated translations; `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx`; root `.changeset/`. Never `packages/spec/**`, never `ui/**` (stop on breach).
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Serial constraints cleared: #32132 (seat 3) shares the SAML branch of `runSsoCallbackScope` and `runSsoCallback`: one hook line each here, logic in the new file; the second to land merges `origin/main`. #32085 (unclaimed) keeps certificate, SSO URL, entity id and OIDC secret editing.
